load_meshes_from_glb: load all meshes from a GLB file into a list of named PyTorch3D Meshes objects
save_mesh_to_glb: save a PyTorch3D Meshes object to a GLB file using the MeshGlbFormat writer
register_glb_format_with_io: register the MeshGlbFormat interpreter with a PyTorch3D IO instance for loading GLB files
make_node_transform: convert a glTF node transform dictionary into a PyTorch3D Transform3d object
get_texture_for_mesh: extract a TexturesVertex, TexturesUV, or None texture object from a glTF mesh primitive
